snippet.title: Apoptosis // Chapter 1 Release!
snippet.description:
You are born into a cold, rusty facility covered in gore. Use your wits to navigate illogical environments while narrowly avoiding traps and entities that solely wish to rend you apart. Will you discover your true purpose or succumb to hopelessness like the other miserable creatures trapped within its walls?

(This game is intended for a certain audience and contains violence, gore and mature themes)

Try it out here:
- https://ili-awa.itch.io/apoptosis
- https://twitter.com/awa_ili
